text: dsh-login-gateway 是面向 DSH Web 的网页网关插件，通过 web profile 注入启动流程，在本机 DSH Web 前提供独立登录页面和反向代理。它把通过登录的浏览器请求转发到本地 Harness，并支持设置访问路径、监听地址和端口，以及配置反向代理选项。用户还可以在网关设置页管理登录资料，浏览工作区文件，并预览 PDF、Markdown 和文本等文档；拖入的非图片文档会保存到 DSH_HOME 下并在输入框插入文件引用。适合需要从浏览器访问云端 DSH 工作区并查看文档的用户。插件不依赖外部 API 服务，首次启动可生成登录凭据并在本机保存状态。

dsh-login-gateway adds a login page and reverse proxy for DSH Web, forwarding browsers to local Harness. Users can manage gateway settings, browse files, preview Markdown and text, and save dropped documents locally. No external API service is required; generated credentials are stored on the host.
想给云端运行的 DSH Web 加一个网页登录入口。
我想从浏览器登录后访问本机的 DSH 工作区。
I need a browser login page in front of my DSH Web workspace.
dsh-login-gateway 的功能「登录后访问 DSH」：网关提供网页登录表单，验证登录后将浏览器请求代理到本地 DSH Web。访问路径、监听地址和端口可在设置中调整。
dsh-login-gateway 的功能「工作区文件浏览与预览」：网关界面可浏览工作区文件，并将 Markdown 文档渲染成预览页；拖入的非图片文件会保存到本机上传目录并插入对话引用。

dsh-login-gateway README · Overview：Official `dsh web` only binds to localhost (`127.0.0.1`) and cannot be exposed directly to public networks. This plugin provides an authenticated entry point with a username/password login wall and reverse proxies authenticated traffic to your local DeepSeek Harness instance.

dsh-login-gateway README · Overview：It is designed for deploying Harness on cloud servers while securely accessing the workspace via browser. By default, it listens on port `8080` under the `/dsh` path prefix to avoid conflicting with the default web port (`3080`).

Repository topics: `dsh-plugin`, `dsh-category-security`. The distributed package contains no hardcoded credentials, domains, or public IPs; credentials are generated and stored exclusively on your host machine.

dsh-login-gateway README · Installation：Requires [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness).

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kunalgupta25/dsh-login-gateway
dsh web --trusted-host YOUR_PUBLIC_IP --trusted-host your.example.com
```

Access in your browser:

```text
http://YOUR_PUBLIC_IP:8080/dsh
```

To install from a local path:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-login-gateway
```

dsh-login-gateway README · Mobile Access：This plugin focuses on authentication and proxying and preserves the official desktop layout.

If you primarily access your workspace from a mobile browser, consider pairing it with the community portrait layout plugin [dsh-web-mobile](https://github.com/mexiaosqwq/dsh-web-mobile) in the same `web` profile:

dsh-login-gateway README · Mobile Access：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kunalgupta25/dsh-login-gateway
dsh plugin --profile web add github:mexiaosqwq/dsh-web-mobile
dsh web --trusted-host YOUR_PUBLIC_IP --trusted-host your.example.com
```

`dsh-login-gateway` manages authentication and routing, while `dsh-web-mobile` (package name `@dsh-external/dsh-mobile-nav`) provides mobile drawers, full-width chat layouts, and touch-adapted settings without affecting desktop displays.
dsh-login-gateway README · Quick Start & Configuration：For full setup instructions, configuration fields, and Nginx configurations, see [docs/setup.md](docs/setup.md).

dsh-login-gateway README · Quick Start & Configuration：1. **Initial Credentials**: If a password was not preconfigured, find the generated credentials in the `dsh web` console output labeled `generated login`.
2. **Gateway Settings**: After logging in, navigate to **Settings → Gateway** and click **Gateway Settings** to change username, password, port, and proxy options. You can also log out from this panel.
3. **Trusted Hosts**: The startup command must include `--trusted-host <host>`, or official API endpoints will reject incoming traffic.
4. **Reverse Proxy / Nginx**: If placing Nginx or Caddy in front, enable "Trust Reverse Proxy" and proxy `/dsh`, `/assets/`, `/plugins/`, `/api`, `/dsh-image-gen`, and `/query-balance` to the gateway port.
5. **Document Drops**: Dragging non-image documents (PDF, Markdown, text) into the browser uploads them to the server and inserts `@filename` references directly into the input prompt. Standard image attachments (PNG, JPEG, WebP, GIF) continue through the native media bar.

dsh-login-gateway README · Development：```bash
npm install
npm test
```
